Class H3BeaconOverlayRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.renderers.H3BeaconOverlayRenderer
public class H3BeaconOverlayRenderer extends Object
Renders dynamic event beacon alerts, ping radar rings, and scenario HUD badges.

Extracted from H3MapCanvas to fulfill SRP and decouple event-driven alert animations and HUD overlays from the main geographic render loop.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
